articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Anthony Scaramucci Criticizes Trump, Cathie Wood Foresees Crisis And Oil Prices Set To Skyrocket: This Week In Economy
articles.summary: Anthony Scaramucci criticized Trump’s economic policies while Cathie Wood warned of a potential global financial crisis.
articles._summary: The week was buzzing with a variety of stories that kept the financial world on its toes. From Anthony Scaramucci ‘s critique of President Donald Trump ‘s economic policies to Cathie Wood ‘s warning of a looming global financial crisis, there was no shortage of news. Let’s dive into the top five stories that made headlines. Former White House communications director Anthony Scaramucci took to social media to voice his concerns about Trump’s economic strategy. Scaramucci criticized the president for his lack of economic philosophy and the escalating federal spending under his administration. He highlighted that Trump’s spending reached $8.2 trillion in his first term and is projected to hit between $9 trillion and $10 trillion in his current term. CEO of Ark Invest , Cathie Wood , issued a warning about a potential global financial crisis.
articles._zh_headline: 安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇批评特朗普，凯西·伍德预见危机和油价将飙升：本周经济
articles._zh_summary: 本周充斥着各种让金融界保持警惕的故事。从安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇对唐纳德·特朗普总统经济政策的批评，到凯茜·伍德对迫在眉睫的全球金融危机的警告，新闻不绝于耳。让我们深入探讨成为头条新闻的前五个故事。前白宫通讯主管安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇在社交媒体上表达了他对特朗普经济战略的担忧。斯卡拉穆奇批评总统缺乏经济哲学以及他的政府不断增加的联邦支出。他强调，特朗普第一任期内的支出达到 8.2 万亿美元，预计当前任期将达到 9 万亿至 10 万亿美元。 Ark Invest 首席执行官 Cathie Wood 对潜在的全球金融危机发出警告。

articles.author: Benzinga Neuro
articles.headline: Tech's Grip On S&P 500 Hits Record 39% As AI Rally Pushes Concentration Beyond Dot-Com Peak
articles.summary: Tech sector's share of S&P 500 at all-time high of 39%, surpassing previous highs in dot-com era and energy sector, with AI leadership driving gains.
articles._summary: In a post on social media platform X , the Kobeissi Letter noted that the tech sector’s weight has more than doubled since the 2020 pandemic and has moved beyond prior extremes. It also said tech’s current slice is above the dot-com era high of about 33% and the energy sector’s roughly 31% crest in the 1980s. The takeaway for investors is portfolio concentration risk, as a narrow group of companies increasingly drives index returns while reducing the benefits of diversification.
articles._zh_headline: 科技股对标普 500 指数的掌控力达到创纪录的 39%，人工智能反弹将集中度推向互联网高峰期之外
articles._zh_summary: 《Kobeissi Letter》在社交媒体平台 X 上的一篇帖子中指出，自 2020 年大流行以来，科技行业的权重增加了一倍多，并且已经超出了之前的极端水平。它还表示，科技行业目前的份额高于互联网时代约 33% 的高点，也高于能源行业 20 世纪 80 年代约 31% 的峰值。投资者面临的问题是投资组合集中风险，因为一小部分公司日益推动指数回报，同时降低了多元化的好处。

articles.author: Benzinga Neuro
articles.headline: Apple's Push For Chinese Memory Chips Isn't The Micron Threat Investors Think It Is, Analyst Says: 5 Reasons Why
articles.summary: Fears over Apple's use of cheaper chips from China's CXMT hurting Micron may be overblown.
articles._summary: In a post on X, Milk Road AI analyst Melvin said investors are focusing on the wrong part of the memory market. While Apple’s potential use of chips from China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) could pressure commodity DRAM suppliers, he argued Micron has largely shifted its focus to premium HBM products powering AI data centers, where CXMT remains years behind.
articles._zh_headline: 分析师表示，苹果推动中国存储芯片并不是投资者所认为的美光威胁：5个原因
articles._zh_summary: Milk Road AI 分析师 Melvin 在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，投资者关注的是内存市场的错误部分。虽然苹果可能使用中国长鑫存储技术公司 (CXMT) 的芯片可能会给商品 DRAM 供应商带来压力，但他认为美光已将其重点转向为 AI 数据中心提供动力的优质 HBM 产品，而 CXMT 在这方面仍落后数年。

articles.headline: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
articles.summary: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.
articles._summary: The US has conducted new strikes on Iran, following a drone attack on a Panama-flagged vessel in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday. US Central Command (Centcom) said it hit multiple targets across Iran in direct response to "continued aggression" against commercial shipping. In retaliation, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it has launched missiles and drones at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain, in a statement shared to state media. Following the exchange of fire, the US and Iran accused each other of violating the ceasefire agreement. Centcom said in a statement, "Iran was given a chance to honor the ceasefire agreement but elected not to when its forces launched a one-way attack drone that hit MT Kiku," a Panama-flagged tanker. In response, it said, US fighter jets conducted strikes on 10 Iranian military targets at multiple locations in and near the Strait of Hormuz.
articles._zh_headline: 美国和伊朗交锋并指责对方违反停火协议
articles._zh_summary: 周六，一艘悬挂巴拿马国旗的船只在霍尔木兹海峡遭到无人机袭击后，美国对伊朗进行了新的打击。美国中央司令部（Centcom）表示，它袭击了伊朗各地的多个目标，以直接回应针对商业航运的“持续侵略”。作为报复，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）在向官方媒体分享的一份声明中表示，它已向科威特和巴林的美国基础设施发射了导弹和无人机。交火后，美国和伊朗互相指责对方违反停火协议。中央司令部在一份声明中表示，“伊朗本来有机会遵守停火协议，但当伊朗军队发射一架单向攻击无人机击中一艘悬挂巴拿马国旗的油轮 MT Kiku 时，伊朗选择不这样做。”作为回应，美国战斗机对霍尔木兹海峡及其附近多个地点的 10 个伊朗军事目标进行了袭击。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: MAGS ETF: Magnificent 7 Outflows Surge as Investors Rotate Into DRAM
articles.summary: US investors are increasingly skeptical about the Magnificent 7, with most of these stocks still trading well below their all-time highs.
articles._summary: Data compiled by ETFDB shows that investors have continued dumping the MAGS ETF. Outflows have jumped to over $607 million in the last six months, with its assets under management dropping to $3.6 billion. The ongoing performance is primarily because most Magnificent 7 companies have retreated in the past few months. Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG ) stock dropped by 17.5% from its highest point this year.
articles._zh_headline: MAGS ETF：随着投资者转向 DRAM，7 月份资金流出激增
articles._zh_summary: ETFDB 编制的数据显示，投资者继续抛售 MAGS ETF。过去六个月，资金外流跃升至超过 6.07 亿美元，其管理的资产降至 36 亿美元。持续的表现主要是因为大多数 Magnificent 7 公司在过去几个月中都出现了下滑。 Alphabet（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）股价较今年最高点下跌了 17.5%。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Nike Stock Gets A Rude Awakening As Technicals Point To More Weakness Ahead Of Earnings
articles.summary: Nike stock price has gotten a rude awakening as its turnaround takes long to take shape and analysts remain bearish ahead of earnings
articles._summary: In a recent note, Stifel Nicolaus lowered the Nike stock target from $56 to $50, while Deutsche Bank’s Krisztina Katai slashed from $51 to $43. Oppenheimer’s Brian Nagel and BTIG’s Robert Drbul cut their targets to $60 and $55, respectively. The general view among analysts is that Nike’s business is facing major challenges and that its turnaround strategy is taking time to generate returns. Analysts expect the upcoming results to show that its revenue dropped by 2.19% in the quarter to $10.85 billion.
articles._zh_headline: 耐克股票猛然觉醒，因为技术面显示盈利前将出现更多疲软
articles._zh_summary: 在最近的一份报告中，Stifel Nicolaus 将耐克的股价目标从 56 美元下调至 50 美元，而德意志银行的 Krisztina Katai 将目标股价从 51 美元下调至 43 美元。 Oppenheimer 的 Brian Nagel 和 BTIG 的 Robert Drbul 分别将目标下调至 60 美元和 55 美元。分析师普遍认为，耐克的业务正面临重大挑战，其扭亏为盈战略需要时间才能产生回报。分析师预计即将公布的业绩显示，该季度营收将下降 2.19%，至 108.5 亿美元。

articles.author: Shomik Sen Bhattacharjee
articles.headline: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra Says Watching Berkeley’s ‘The Play’ Helped Shape A Leadership Quality He Later Brought To SanDisk
articles.summary: Micron's CEO credits a legendary college football play for teaching him tenacity. The lesson helped him lead SanDisk and Micron to success.
articles._summary: During the 1982 "Big Game" between the UC Berkeley Cal Bears and the Stanford Cardinal, Mehrotra watched from the stands as a young Berkeley student. With four seconds left, Cal pulled off a five-lateral kickoff return through the Stanford marching band to score a game-winning touchdown. In an interview with Business Insider, Mehrotra said he still remembers the moment vividly. "I was there, and it still gives me goosebumps," he said. "It was extremely exciting, an unbelievable finish."
articles._zh_headline: 美光首席执行官桑杰·梅赫罗特拉 (Sanjay Mehrotra) 表示，观看伯克利大学的“The Play”有助于塑造他后来带到 SanDisk 的领导素质
articles._zh_summary: 1982 年，加州大学伯克利分校熊队 (UC Berkeley Cal Bears) 与斯坦福大学红雀队 (Stanford Cardinal) 之间的“重大比赛”期间，作为一名年轻的伯克利学生，梅赫罗特拉 (Mehrotra) 在看台上观看了比赛。还剩四秒时，卡尔在斯坦福军乐队中完成五次横向开球回攻，取得了赢得比赛的达阵。梅赫罗特拉在接受《商业内幕》采访时表示，他仍然清楚地记得那一刻。 “我当时就在那里，但至今仍让我起鸡皮疙瘩，”他说。 “这非常令人兴奋，令人难以置信的结局。”
